video_title: Steph Curry floors Luka Dončić, Yaxel Lendeborg is Showing Out for the Warriors

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: defensive positioning and the risk of overcommitting on defense
quotes.excerpt: When a defender does that, especially when it's not a high-energy play, what does that mean?

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: As a defender, when they go down, you saw how quick he went down. It was almost like he got the rug pulled from under him. When a defender does that, especially when it's not a high-energy play, what does that mean? Does that mean that you overcompensated, that you overplayed?

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: The reason you'll see people do this, and normally they're going to do it with a Steph Curry, a James Harden, a shot fake with Steph Curry is small separation and look up. Some players like me, I could get you like that if it's a swing-swing and the energy of basketball shows when he might look up. Let me hurry up because I'm already behind. But if I'm just dribbling and I look at the rim, nobody's going to leave their stance. They don't think I'm going to shoot it that quick. They don't think it's going up.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: why Steph Curry's shot fake is so effective against defenders
quotes.excerpt: When Steph Curry looks up, you want to jump out of whatever movement you're doing to block.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: When Steph Curry looks up, you want to jump out of whatever movement you're doing to block. So when Steph faked it and looked back down, he tried to delete what he was trying to do. He was going for the first one. He wanted that first contest. He thought the first one was going up, so when he put his hands back down and tried to slide, he just forgot to take his right leg and kick it out.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He retracted through and tried to delete what he did.

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: defensive fundamentals and avoiding getting caught out of position
quotes.excerpt: I never put all my weight onto the balls of my heels.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I never put all my weight onto the balls of my heels. I know that's not the way you're supposed to play defensively, but it's for reasons like this. I never want to get caught above the three-point line or above the free-throw line with my pants down just trying to recover or to turn around or to look up because somebody's already in their shot motion.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: With Steph, it's out of the parking lot. You got to be like that out of the parking lot.

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg's potential and role with the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I do think he's the perfect guy to now give the torch to after Draymond.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Do you think this is the confidence he needs to try and get rolling in this top of the rookie board?

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I wouldn't say the top of the rookie board because I don't know how long he can sustain 30-point games in this type of environment because Steph got to get his, Draymond got to get his. I do think he's the perfect guy to now give the torch to after Draymond. It's like the setup looks really good. He can be a better help for them in that role than I think Draymond ever could be.

quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: comparing Yaxel Lendeborg's offensive versatility to Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't have all the defensive tools Draymond did at that point, but offensively, he's got those.
quotes.quote: He can pass the torch, especially offensively, because he's kind of like Draymond. He doesn't have all the defensive tools Draymond did at that point, but offensively, he's got those and more. So he can be a better help for them in that role than I think Draymond ever could be. And he commands the defense. Even if he's not playing well specifically, he still wants the offense to run through him.
